_comment: PHASE-2 skeleton for a GSEB Gujarati (દ્વિતીય ભાષા, std 6-10) learning plan. Shape authority: reference/phase2_contract.md — its mechanisms were verified against the LP2 validator during the Hindi (CBSE) run and carry over unchanged, but every CBSE VALUE is provenance, not portable: the GSEB board/medium segments and DB ids below are PROVISIONAL until VERIFY-1/VERIFY-2 resolve them against the live server. Values here are TYPE EXAMPLES, never content to copy - see reference/no_hallucination_policy.md. GSEB PDFs are image-only: original_chunk is transcribed from the rendered page, never from a text layer (reference/gujarati_verbatim.md). Keys beginning with _ are notes in this skeleton only - the emitted plan carries exactly the 32 root keys and 31 topic keys of the contract, plus the contract's own _activate.
subject: Gujarati
_ids_note: chapter_id = {board}_{medium}_{subject}{grade}_ch{unit_number}, all lowercase; plan_id = {chapter_id}_v{version}, no _standard_ segment, and the server assigns the real version. The medium slot is the MEDIUM OF INSTRUCTION, not the subject language, and a wrong value does not fail loudly — it uploads clean under the wrong medium column. gseb_eng_gujarati{grade}_ch{N} is PROVISIONAL: confirm both segments against the live server (VERIFY-1) before the first upload. See reference/naming_conventions.md.
_db_ids_note: publication_id is REQUIRED and the server REJECTS null — the null here is an unfilled slot, not a shippable value. GSEB's publication row and every chapter_master_id are fetched from the education DB into upload_reference/chapter_master_map.json (VERIFY-2), never invented and never derived by arithmetic; CBSE's publication 1 / chapter_master 354 do not transfer. subject_ref_id and medium_id are server-injected — write null unless a real GSEB subject record is confirmed.
chapter_name: <પાઠનું નામ, ગુજરાતી લિપિમાં, છપાયું છે તે જ રીતે>
_source_note: textbook is the reader's PRINTED title for THIS standard and textbook_url is the local PDF path until a hosted URL exists — profiles/boards/gseb_gujarati.md maps std+chapter to both, and 11_pages.json records the missing URL as a gap. textbook_pages is the printed folio range, not the pdf page range.
guiding_question: <આ જ પાઠમાંથી તારવેલો પ્રશ્ન, ગુજરાતીમાં — profile માંથી નકલ કરેલો નહીં>

objectives.objective_text: <12-30 words, ગુજરાતીમાં એક ધ્યેય, આ જ દૃશ્ય પર આધારિત — બીજા કોઈ પાઠમાં બંધ બેસે નહીં>

modules._poem_only: difficult_words and overall_rhyme_scheme are emitted for કાવ્ય modules only; omit or null for ગદ્ય. See reference/alankar_chhand.md.

difficult_words.example: <a FRESH everyday sentence, not the poem's own line>

overall_rhyme_scheme.note: <the pattern and its effect; any chapter-wide ટેક>

topics.original_chunk: <EXACT ગુજરાતી verbatim, transcribed from the rendered page — line breaks, માત્રા, અનુસ્વાર, ચંદ્રબિંદુ, જોડાક્ષર, ળ/લ અને શ/ષ/સ ભેદ, કવિની છાપ preserved; '.' as printed, never '।'; no Roman, no Devanagari, no transliteration>
topics.explanation: <55-90 words: શું બની રહ્યું છે + અર્થ + પ્રથમ વપરાશે સાથે-સાથે શબ્દાર્થ + the deeper reading WHERE THE PASSAGE CARRIES IT>
topics.real_life_example: <55-90 words: ONE ભારતીય દૃષ્ટાંત inside the world of a child at THIS standard; may end on a question>
topics._poem_only_topic: figures_of_speech and rhyme_scheme are for કાવ્ય topics; [] and null for ગદ્ય. NEVER invent a device to fill the field.

concepts._concept_id_note: c is CHAPTER-CONTINUOUS: M1.S2.T3 carries .C3, not .C1

media.teaching_notes: <how a teacher uses it; if reused, name the source frame id here>
media.negative_prompt: <the baseline in reference/field_shape_rules.md — this pack's list adds 'Devanagari script labels' beside 'Roman script labels'>
media.generation_prompt: <self-contained; narrator bar carries one line of ગુજરાતી in Gujarati script. Empty ONLY when image_url is a reused frame — no Gujarati frame pool exists yet, so every scene is authored>
